changeSet.comment: Keep the readiness decisions out of the evidence snapshot so they can be read in bulk.
changeSet.sql:
-- A snapshot carries one entry per staged file, so a repository-tree capture makes it -- megabytes. Postgres cannot read one key out of a TOASTed jsonb without detoasting the -- whole value, so reporting on 200 reviews meant decompressing 200 snapshots for a few -- kilobytes of answer. The decisions move to their own column; the snapshot stays put. UPDATE agent_job SET review_readiness = evidence_snapshot -> 'automatedReviewReadiness' WHERE jsonb_typeof(evidence_snapshot) = 'object' AND jsonb_exists(evidence_snapshot, 'automatedReviewReadiness');
-- The snapshot stored the source manifest twice: once as the bytes staged in the sandbox -- and once as the object they were rendered from. Nothing ever read the second copy. UPDATE agent_job SET evidence_snapshot = evidence_snapshot - 'artifactSourceManifest' WHERE jsonb_typeof(evidence_snapshot) = 'object' AND jsonb_exists(evidence_snapshot, 'artifactSourceManifest');

changeSet.comment: One list of needs with a stance, and capture strictness read off the source contract.
changeSet.sql:
-- Two lists that differed only in whether an absent source refused the review, and a -- completeness/content pair restated on every entry that every practice had already spelled -- the same way for a given source. The stance survives as a word; the strictness moves to the -- source contract, so it is dropped here rather than carried. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION migrate_policy_to_needs(policy jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $migrate_needs$ SELECT (policy - 'requiredEvidence' - 'optionalContext') || jsonb_build_object('needs', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(need ORDER BY need->>'sourceKind') FROM ( SELECT jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'stance', 'REQUIRED') AS need FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(policy->'requiredEvidence', '[]'::jsonb)) AS entry UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'stance', 'CONTEXTUAL') AS need FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(policy->'optionalContext', '[]'::jsonb)) AS entry ) AS needs ), '[]'::jsonb)) $migrate_needs$;
UPDATE practice SET automated_review_policy = migrate_policy_to_needs(automated_review_policy) WHERE jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'requiredEvidence'); UPDATE curated_practice_override SET automated_review_policy = migrate_policy_to_needs(automated_review_policy) WHERE automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'requiredEvidence'); ALTER TABLE practice_revision DISABLE TRIGGER practice_revision_immutable_update; UPDATE practice_revision SET automated_review_policy = migrate_policy_to_needs(automated_review_policy) WHERE automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'requiredEvidence'); -- Same reason as -21: the policy digest feeds the review-rule fingerprint, so every stored -- one now describes a policy shape that no longer exists. CatalogProvenanceBackfill -- recomputes them on the next boot. UPDATE practice_revision SET review_rule_fingerprint = NULL WHERE slug IS NOT NULL AND automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE practice_revision ENABLE TRIGGER practice_revision_immutable_update; DROP FUNCTION migrate_policy_to_needs(jsonb);

-- The stance is recoverable; the strictness is not, because it is no longer written per -- practice anywhere. It is restored from the source contract as it stood when this -- changeset ran, which is the same value every practice had stated — that equality is -- what licensed moving it, and is pinned by EvidencePolicyRedundancyTest. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION restore_policy_evidence_lists(policy jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $restore_lists$ SELECT (policy - 'needs') || jsonb_build_object('requiredEvidence', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE entry->>'sourceKind' WHEN 'scm.pull-request.diff' THEN jsonb_build_object( 'sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'completeness', 'COMPLETE', 'content', 'NON_EMPTY') WHEN 'scm.pull-request.core' THEN jsonb_build_object( 'sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'completeness', 'COMPLETE') WHEN 'scm.issue.core' THEN jsonb_build_object( 'sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'completeness', 'COMPLETE') WHEN 'slack.conversation.thread' THEN jsonb_build_object( 'sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'completeness', 'COMPLETE') ELSE jsonb_build_object( 'sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind', 'completeness', 'NO_REQUIREMENT') END ORDER BY entry->>'sourceKind') FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(policy->'needs', '[]'::jsonb)) AS entry WHERE entry->>'stance' = 'REQUIRED' ), '[]'::jsonb)) || jsonb_build_object('optionalContext', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', entry->>'sourceKind') ORDER BY entry->>'sourceKind') FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(policy->'needs', '[]'::jsonb)) AS entry WHERE entry->>'stance' = 'CONTEXTUAL' ), '[]'::jsonb)); $restore_lists$;
UPDATE practice SET automated_review_policy = restore_policy_evidence_lists(automated_review_policy) WHERE jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'needs'); UPDATE curated_practice_override SET automated_review_policy = restore_policy_evidence_lists(automated_review_policy) WHERE automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'needs'); ALTER TABLE practice_revision DISABLE TRIGGER practice_revision_immutable_update; UPDATE practice_revision SET automated_review_policy = restore_policy_evidence_lists(automated_review_policy) WHERE automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(automated_review_policy, 'needs'); UPDATE practice_revision SET review_rule_fingerprint = NULL WHERE slug IS NOT NULL AND automated_review_policy IS NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE practice_revision ENABLE TRIGGER practice_revision_immutable_update; DROP FUNCTION restore_policy_evidence_lists(jsonb);
